findings.title: Observe agent changes when no generation is running
findings.why_it_matters: A source, draft, or published deck created by the agent does not appear in an already-open Study workspace. Its only periodic refresh starts after this UI already knows about a running generation, so agent work and updates from the other native pane stay stale until a local mutation or remount. Observe shared revisions even while idle, preserving unsaved form edits.
findings.suggested_fix: Subscribe to shared library revision events or poll snapshots whenever a library is bound, not only during known generation jobs. Guard stale responses and preserve dirty settings/draft fields.
